framework: South Dakota state academic standards: World Languages
subject: World Languages

source.publisher: South Dakota state education agency (machine-readable via Common Standards Project / ASN)

units.title: Communication: Communicate in Languages Other Than English

topics.title: Communication: Communicate in Languages Other Than English

subtopics.title: Communication: Communicate in Languages Other Than English

outcomes.text: Students engage in conversations, provide and obtain information, express feelings and emotions, and exchange opinions.
Students understand and interpret written and spoken language on a variety of topics.
Students present information, concepts, and ideas to an audience of listeners or readers on a variety of topics.

units.title: Cultures: Gain Knowledge and Understanding of Other Cultures

topics.title: Cultures: Gain Knowledge and Understanding of Other Cultures

subtopics.title: Cultures: Gain Knowledge and Understanding of Other Cultures

outcomes.text: Students demonstrate an understanding of the relationship between the practices and perspectives of the culture studied.
Students demonstrate an understanding of the relationship between the products and perspectives of the culture studied.

units.title: Connections: Connect with Other Disciplines and Acquire Information

topics.title: Connections: Connect with Other Disciplines and Acquire Information

subtopics.title: Connections: Connect with Other Disciplines and Acquire Information

outcomes.text: Students reinforce and further their knowledge of other disciplines through the world language.
Students acquire information and recognize the distinctive viewpoints that are only available through the world language and its cultures.

units.title: Comparisons: Develop Insight into the Nature of Language and Culture

topics.title: Comparisons: Develop Insight into the Nature of Language and Culture

subtopics.title: Comparisons: Develop Insight into the Nature of Language and Culture

outcomes.text: Students demonstrate understanding of the nature of language through comparisons of the language studied and their own.
Students demonstrate understanding of the concept of culture through comparisons of the cultures studied and their own.

units.title: Communities: Participate in Multilingual Communities at Home & Around…

topics.title: Communities: Participate in Multilingual Communities at Home & Around…

subtopics.title: Communities: Participate in Multilingual Communities at Home & Around…

outcomes.text: Students use the language both within and beyond the school setting.
Students show evidence of becoming life‐long learners by using the language for personal enjoyment and enrichment.
